assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area boundaries are provisional rough polygons from the repository site package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial calculations are approximate; replace with official polygons and recalculate every area-sensitive layer and metric.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height limits, density, green ratio, and setbacks are unknown (planning_limits.json registers them as missing).
assumptions.impact: All building-scale proposals are conceptual and give no approved values.

assumptions.statement: Jing-Zhang Railway heritage protection scope, green/blue lines, and heritage control lines are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Design near the heritage corridor is directional only; the constraints layer is a reference, not an official redline.

assumptions.statement: Land ownership, current buildings, and parcel boundaries are not provided.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classifications are methodological suggestions, not parcel conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Underground utilities, pipeline capacities, rail alignments, and engineering feasibility are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Transport, rail, and municipal proposals are conceptual frameworks; no engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios must not surveil individuals, must allow human review, must be revertible, and must publish only de-identified data.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards respect privacy and human-review boundaries; no surveillance-centric deployments.

assumptions.statement: The naming system (会车京张 / JINGZHANG PASSING-BY, one belt / three stations / two tracks / two wings / nine passes) is an agent design proposal.
assumptions.impact: Names and logo are concepts for professional teams to deepen; no trademark clearance is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, community operation, scenario openness, and international communication are conceptual operating mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government arrangements, budgets, or approvals.
